method: Documented current-account income: buy USD and wire
who: 境外个人 / foreign passport holder with lawful PRC current-account RMB income
when_to_use: Salary, service fees, current transfers or other lawful income whose source and tax treatment can be documented.
documents: Valid ID, amount-bearing source-of-funds documents, tax voucher / 完税凭证 / 免税证明 or 税务备案表; wire form and receiving-bank details.
limit: Art. 59 states no amount ceiling; tax record-filing applies to single payments above USD 50,000.
advantages: The standard documented route for a foreign individual; whole amount can be handled as one bank wire; no annual quota needed when documents exist.
drawbacks: Bank must accept source and tax evidence; branch practice varies; unpaid underlying PRC tax blocks the route.
conversion_tax_notes: No conversion tax found; 20%/3%-45% PRC IIT may attach to the underlying income; U.S. §988 and reporting remain separate.

method: Domestic-individual documented purchase above the convenience amount
who: 境内个人 (Chinese citizen, or foreigner resident ≥1 year on the Decree 532 reading)
when_to_use: The bank classifies the account as 境内个人 and genuine purpose/amount documents exist.
documents: Valid ID, 个人购汇申请书, amount-bearing purpose documents; above USD 50,000/day outward wire needs transaction materials.
limit: USD 50,000/person/year is a convenience/documentation threshold, not a hard cap.
advantages: No ceiling when documents exist; counter or e-banking permitted under Art. 55.
drawbacks: Applicant is responsible for the accuracy of the purchase application; purchase and remittance purposes must be consistent; splitting is prohibited.
conversion_tax_notes: Same underlying-income and U.S. reporting rules as B01.

method: Wire foreign currency already held in a PRC FX account
who: Holder of an existing foreign-currency savings account
when_to_use: Part or all of the balance is already USD/FX, not CNY.
documents: Valid ID and wire form; 境内个人 above USD 50,000/day also needs amount-bearing materials.
limit: Art. 65 states no amount threshold for an 境外个人's FX-account wire; Art. 64 sets the domestic-individual threshold.
advantages: No FX purchase, so no bid/ask spread; only published wire/cable cost.
drawbacks: Does not convert CNY; unavailable for a pure RMB balance.
conversion_tax_notes: No conversion; U.S. §988 disposition of nonfunctional currency and reporting still need review.

method: Reconvert unused RMB with the original exchange slip
who: 境外个人 who previously converted FX into RMB and did not use it all
when_to_use: Original 兑换水单 is dated within 24 months and the unused amount is identifiable.
documents: Valid ID, original exchange slip, wire form.
limit: Up to the unused amount on the slip; slip valid 24 months from exchange.
advantages: No income/tax source documents needed beyond the slip; simple bank workflow.
drawbacks: Useless for RMB earned/received in China or for old/missing slips.
conversion_tax_notes: Returning one's own unused FX is not identified as new income in the sources read.

method: Small ID-only reconversion without the original slip
who: 境外个人 with small unused RMB amounts
when_to_use: Only within the official daily ID-only limits; not a route for a large balance in one transaction.
documents: Valid ID.
limit: ≤USD 500/day (≤USD 1,000/day at border-side outlets) on ID alone; larger amounts need the original slip.
advantages: Minimal paperwork for small amounts.
drawbacks: Cannot execute USD 10,000-400,000 as a single lawful transaction under this rule; no banknote fee published.
conversion_tax_notes: Not priced; all cost cells are blank and flagged.

method: USD 50,000 annual convenience amount (PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID)
who: 境外个人 holding the PRC Foreign Permanent Resident ID Card
when_to_use: The user actually holds that ID and can wait one calendar year per USD 50,000 tranche.
documents: Valid ID inside the convenience amount; documents above it.
limit: USD 50,000 equivalent/person/calendar year on ID alone for purchase; not a hard total cap.
advantages: No source/tax documents inside the yearly amount.
drawbacks: USD 400,000 needs eight calendar years; a U.S. passport alone does not qualify.
conversion_tax_notes: No conversion tax found; U.S. reporting applies each year.

method: Proceeds from selling PRC real property
who: 境外个人 who owned and sold onshore commercial/residential property
when_to_use: Title transfer and tax payment are complete and the RMB is the sale proceeds.
documents: Passport, registered transfer contract, title-transfer proof, tax voucher; 税务备案表 above USD 50,000 unless waived.
limit: Remittance cannot exceed transfer price minus taxes/fees (and ownership share).
advantages: Direct bank handling for a genuine large capital-account exit; fixed document list.
drawbacks: 20% IIT on gain and other property taxes are case-specific; original cost needed.
conversion_tax_notes: 20% PRC IIT on gain; U.S. foreign tax credit may apply to the same income.

method: Inheritance transfer (继承转移)
who: Foreign citizen inheriting assets from a decedent with a PRC hukou
when_to_use: There is a genuine estate, inheritance proof and tax certificate.
documents: Application to SAFE at decedent's last hukou, inheritance/property documents, tax certificate, own overseas account details.
limit: One application for the estate; bank may remit once or in instalments within the approved amount.
advantages: Dedicated legal route for large inherited wealth.
drawbacks: Discretionary approval and evidence-heavy; Chinese inheritance-tax treatment not affirmatively confirmed.
conversion_tax_notes: PRC tax certificate required; U.S. Form 3520 reports foreign bequests >USD 100,000.

method: Emigrant property transfer (移民转移)
who: Former mainland resident who emigrated and cancelled PRC hukou
when_to_use: Assets were owned before emigrant status and hukou cancellation/settlement proof exist.
documents: SAFE application at former hukou, cancellation certificate, certified settlement proof, property/source and tax documents.
limit: Approved amount; bank may remit once or in instalments since 2014.
advantages: No annual quota; dedicated route for a former resident's savings/property.
drawbacks: Unavailable to someone who never held mainland residence; approval is evidence-heavy.
conversion_tax_notes: Tax certificates from the place where income/gain arose are required.

method: Dividend / profit distribution from a PRC company
who: Foreign shareholder of a domestic company, not a personal savings holder
when_to_use: Money is genuinely distributable corporate profit, not personal CNY savings.
documents: Board/partnership profit-distribution resolution, tax filing form above USD 50,000, company accounts, withholding evidence.
limit: Limited to genuine distributable profit; USD 50,000 is a review threshold.
advantages: Proper route for business profit; no personal annual quota.
drawbacks: Not a personal route; using it for savings is a disguised transfer; treaty eligibility needs evidence.
conversion_tax_notes: 20% statutory IIT on dividends; treaty Art. 9(2) 10% cap for a beneficial owner, subject to self-assessment and retained documents.

method: Cross-border RMB remittance, convert offshore
who: Payer with genuine current-account RMB obligation and a bank offering personal outbound RMB
when_to_use: The underlying transaction can lawfully be settled in RMB and the offshore bank accepts CNY.
documents: Same authenticity documentation as the underlying current-account transaction; receiving-bank CNY details.
limit: Current-account/approved transaction only; no personal outbound RMB tariff or offshore CNH rate published.
advantages: Avoids the onshore conversion step; PBOC notes the 2018 reform allows RMB wherever FX is lawful.
drawbacks: Offshore conversion rate and receiving fee are unknown; no official personal cost; not every bank offers it.
conversion_tax_notes: Same underlying-income and U.S. §988 issues as B01.

method: Overseas UnionPay ATM cash withdrawals
who: Holder of a mainland UnionPay debit card on the RMB account
when_to_use: Small amounts while travelling outside the mainland; not a practical single route for large balances.
documents: Card, PIN, ID; U.S. FinCEN Form 105 if physically carrying >USD 10,000.
limit: RMB 10,000/card/day; RMB 100,000/person/calendar year; breach suspends current+next year.
advantages: No branch FX paperwork for small withdrawals.
drawbacks: BOC fee is only one component; UnionPay rate and ATM-owner fee unknown; USD 400,000 would take decades.
conversion_tax_notes: Cash declaration and U.S. reporting still apply; no all-in cost is published.

method: Carry foreign-currency cash out in person
who: Individual who first lawfully buys the foreign currency
when_to_use: Small amounts; a delivery method, not a way around source/tax documents.
documents: Valid ID; bank permit for USD 5,000-10,000; SAFE permit above USD 10,000 in principle not granted; U.S. FinCEN Form 105 above USD 10,000.
limit: ≤USD 5,000 customs release; USD 5,000-10,000 bank permit; >USD 10,000 generally not allowed.
advantages: No wire or receiving-bank fee if cash already exists.
drawbacks: Banknote withdrawal fee and travel cost unknown; theft/loss risk; 80 trips for USD 400,000 at USD 5,000/trip.
conversion_tax_notes: Cash selling rate equals spot selling on this board; no conversion tax found.

method: Consolidate own/close-relative accounts before one outward wire
who: Accounts of the same person or close relatives in the same subject category
when_to_use: Multiple domestic accounts need to be combined before the lawful outward remittance.
documents: Valid ID; account-category evidence; outward-wire documents for the chosen route.
limit: Transfers between 境内个人 and 境外个人 FX accounts are treated as cross-border.
advantages: One outward wire minimises fixed cable charges.
drawbacks: Does not itself move money out of China; wrong-category transfer triggers cross-border rules.
conversion_tax_notes: Same as the eventual outward route.

method: Genuine service-trade outward payment
who: Individual/institution paying for a real cross-border service
when_to_use: There is a genuine contract/invoice; not for exporting personal savings.
documents: Contract/invoice/settlement list, tax filing form above USD 50,000, wire form.
limit: USD 50,000 per transaction is a review/recordal threshold, not a cap.
advantages: Legitimate channel for genuine services; below USD 50,000 the bank need not ordinarily review documents.
drawbacks: Fabricated background is prohibited and engages Art. 40 penalties; personal savings do not qualify.
conversion_tax_notes: Underlying service income/payment tax rules apply.

method: Foreign investor's share of a lawfully liquidated FIE
who: Foreign investor in a terminated foreign-invested enterprise
when_to_use: Real enterprise, real liquidation and tax actually paid.
documents: Lawful termination, completed liquidation and tax-payment evidence; SAFE/bank approvals.
limit: No amount ceiling stated in Decree 532 Art. 22(3); limited to RMB belonging to the foreign investor.
advantages: Express State Council regulation; covers capital, not just income.
drawbacks: Only for a real liquidation; takes time and professional cost; personal savings out of scope.
conversion_tax_notes: Corporate/withholding tax and tax clearance precede remittance.

method: Direct RMB salary remittance abroad (foreign employee)
who: Foreign employee with lawful RMB salary and a bank offering personal outbound RMB
when_to_use: The underlying payment is genuine current-account remuneration and the bank supports the channel.
documents: Employment/income and tax evidence; receiving-bank CNY account details; bank's RMB cross-border form.
limit: No official personal outbound RMB tariff, offshore conversion rate or receiving fee published.
advantages: PBOC Beijing reports a real foreign employee's RMB salary remittance that avoided an onshore conversion charge.
drawbacks: Does not by itself produce USD; cost is blank; not every bank offers it to individuals.
conversion_tax_notes: Same underlying-income and U.S. §988 issues as B01.

method: Gift / undocumented RMB balance
who: Recipient of a gift or funds whose origin cannot be documented
when_to_use: No verified lawful route was found; do not assume one.
documents: Not established.
limit: Not established.
advantages: None verified.
drawbacks: No official rule read here permits a foreign passport holder to convert and remit undocumented/gift RMB; bank may refuse.
conversion_tax_notes: U.S. Form 3520 may report a foreign gift/bequest >USD 100,000; PRC route unverified.

method: Quota splitting / 'ant moving' through relatives or friends
who: Not applicable
when_to_use: Never; prohibited.
documents: Not applicable.
limit: Not applicable.
advantages: None lawful.
drawbacks: Art. 62 watch-list for current year plus two; SAFE Hebei case treated 52-person splitting as 逃汇; fine up to 30%, 30%-100% if serious.
conversion_tax_notes: Penalty exposure, not a cost model.

method: Private FX swaps, apps, brokers, underground banks
who: Not applicable
when_to_use: Never; prohibited.
documents: Not applicable.
limit: Not applicable.
advantages: None lawful.
drawbacks: Only qualified banks/licensed institutions may convert FX; private channels are illegal; Decree 532 Art. 45 fine up to 30%, 30%-100% if serious.
conversion_tax_notes: Penalty/confiscation exposure, not a cost model.

method: Crypto / stablecoin / RWA conversion
who: Not applicable
when_to_use: Never; prohibited in the PRC under the 2026 notice.
documents: Not applicable.
limit: Not applicable.
advantages: None lawful.
drawbacks: 银发〔2026〕42号 strictly forbids fiat/virtual-currency exchange, unapproved RMB stablecoins and RWA tokenisation; funds have no legal protection.
conversion_tax_notes: Prohibition and possible Art. 39/45 exposure, not a cost model.

method: False documents / false purpose / undeclared excess cash
who: Not applicable
when_to_use: Never; prohibited.
documents: Not applicable.
limit: Not applicable.
advantages: None lawful.
drawbacks: Art. 40 false-document FX purchase, Art. 48 untrue documents up to RMB 50,000, Art. 42 cash breach up to 20%; U.S. CBP seizure/penalties above USD 10,000 undeclared.
conversion_tax_notes: Penalty exposure, not a cost model.
